scope: Self-contained one-elliptic-block research subproblem; not a replacement for the whole nc-cubic project.

manuscript.status: research draft with written proofs, not externally peer reviewed
contributions: Explicit application of the existing general elliptic-block reconstruction to every complex fiber on the specified Hesse open set, with no torsion restriction.
Nonzero second-order marked deformation of the reconstructed cubic.
Algebraic curve of nontrivial algebra deformations with pointwise constant reconstructed cubic pair.
Relative THCR presentation of the central quotient, compatible with base change.
not_claimed: relative dg equivalence of the full residual family
generation for two or more unrestricted infinite-order blocks

performed: Checked standard Sklyanin parameter and central quotient hypotheses at every specified fiber, including h=0.
Reviewed elliptic rotation conjugacy, periodicity normalisation, central-variable Koszul generation and finite grading descent.
Proved the second-order Jacobian class and fixed-model curve statements.
Reviewed the degree-wise flatness and relative central-quotient argument.
proof_review.primary_source_scope: Relevant statements/pages in Walton, De Laet-Le Bruyn, Orlov, Cassidy-Conner-Kirkman-Moore, Elagin, Lin-Zhang, Artebani-Dolgachev and Burke-Stevenson inspected; exact versions and references are in the bibliography. External proofs were not all re-proved.
not_performed: a fully general relative Orlov comparison

computations.arithmetic: exact rational-function identities and finite-field linear algebra; no floating point
computations.limitations: The computations do not constitute a formal proof of the categorical statements.

typesetting.source_pdf_parity: Each PDF has a build receipt containing input and PDF SHA256 snapshots.
typesetting.visual_review: All pages rendered as contact sheets; main theorem and central proof pages inspected at reading scale; no observed clipping or overlap. Notes table layout adjusted to avoid an isolated header.

integration.fixture_result: passed: old proofs preserved, valid paths, collision rejection, changed anchor rejection

delivery.limitation: This turn exposes read-only repository operations and no Library upload operation. Generated and validated files are provided as local artifacts; no external save or push is claimed.
